system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: dealer_filter_by_product and dealer_get_recommendations. Here are my details: my product_type is dummy_product_type_4032, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_1643, my location is dummy_location_2401.

function.name: dealer_filter_by_product
function.description: Filters dealers by product type and crop compatibility. Returns dealers that carry matching products. PUBLIC tool. Location is required. Does NOT verify dealer status or product availability. Fails if location missing, crop_type unsupported, or no matches found.

function.name: dealer_get_recommendations
function.description: Provides dealer recommendations based on crop type, location, and product needs. Requires session_token (personalized). Recommendations are advisory only. Does NOT guarantee product availability. Fails if crop_type unsupported or no dealers match.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.
